name: Univastu India Limited
summary: Univastu India Limited provides works contract services in India. It offers integrated engineering, procurement, and construction services for civil, structural, and infrastructure projects. The company handles various projects for metro stations, sports complexes, hospitals, commercial buildings, cold storages, educational institutions, mass housing, water supply, drainage, roads, and bridges. It also trades in construction materials, including steel, cement, and electrical products. The company serves governmental and private sectors. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Pune, India.
